description.zh: 是否需要在数字人进行播报该条消息的时候进行回调通知，默认值false，具体可参考：[数字人回调事件通知](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html)。
description.en: Specifies whether to send a callback notification when the digital human delivers this message. The default value is false. For more information, see [Digital Human Callback Event Notifications](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html).

description.zh: 会话 SessionID。通过“启动一个数字人”API的返回值获取。
description.en: Session ID. Obtain this value from the return value of the "Start a Digital Human" API.

description.zh: 流式播报扩展对象，不是流式播报，不传该对象。用户需要自己切分文本片段（比如说按照标点符号切分），数字人按照提交文本顺序连续的进行播报
description.en: Stream extension object. Do not pass this object if streaming broadcast is not used. The user must split the text into segments (for example, by punctuation marks), and the digital human broadcasts the segments consecutively in the order they are submitted.

description.zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
description.en: Tenant ID obtained from the Digitized Virtual Human Open Platform.

descriptions.zh: 二方包引入可参考API概览的信息
descriptions.en: For information about importing the second-party package, refer to the API Overview.
